note: Explicit, conservative mapping of provider-native finding types to ATT&CK (Enterprise) technique IDs. Only types where the technique is directly described by the finding are mapped; everything else is intentionally left unmapped (see coverage in summary.json). Entries are review_status=proposed: authored by an AI assistant and awaiting human security-analyst review. 'source' notes where the finding semantics come from; these are NOT vendor-published ATT&CK mappings unless stated.

mappings.justification: Probing open ports on an instance is network service discovery.
mappings.source: AWS GuardDuty finding-type docs (Recon:EC2/PortProbeUnprotectedPort); ATT&CK T1046 definition.

mappings.justification: Repeated SSH login attempts against an instance are brute forcing.
mappings.source: AWS GuardDuty finding-type docs; ATT&CK T1110 definition.

mappings.justification: Repeated RDP login attempts against an instance are brute forcing.
mappings.source: AWS GuardDuty finding-type docs; ATT&CK T1110 definition.

mappings.justification: Instance-role credentials (obtained via the metadata service) used from outside AWS: credential theft from the cloud instance metadata API, then use as a valid cloud account.
mappings.source: AWS GuardDuty finding-type docs; ATT&CK T1552.005 and T1078.004 definitions.

mappings.justification: Disabling CloudTrail logging is disabling cloud logs.
mappings.source: AWS GuardDuty finding-type docs; ATT&CK T1562.008 definition.

mappings.justification: Instance communicating with Bitcoin-related infrastructure indicates mining/resource hijacking (applies to BitcoinTool.B and BitcoinTool.B!DNS).
mappings.source: AWS GuardDuty finding-type docs; ATT&CK T1496 definition.

mappings.justification: Instance querying a known command-and-control endpoint is C2 over an application-layer protocol (sub-technique not determinable from the finding).
mappings.source: AWS GuardDuty finding-type docs (Backdoor:EC2/C&CActivity.B and .B!DNS); ATT&CK T1071 definition.

mappings.justification: Unusual object reads from S3 by an identity correspond to collecting data from cloud storage.
mappings.source: AWS GuardDuty finding-type docs; ATT&CK T1530 definition.

mappings.justification: Granting an IAM role to an unexpected identity is adding cloud roles to an account.
mappings.source: Google SCC Event Threat Detection docs list this category against T1098.003; ATT&CK T1098.003 definition.
